task_text: lift the payload to shelf height

reward_terms.name: position_alignment
reward_terms.rationale: L1 distance from gripper to payload; agent minimizes error in approach. Unchanged -- evidence does not implicate this term.

reward_terms.name: grip_contact
reward_terms.expression: sensor.s_touch_jaw * (1 - clamp(abs(site.grip_center.pos.x - site.payload_center.pos.x) + abs(site.grip_center.pos.y - site.payload_center.pos.y) + abs(site.grip_center.pos.z - site.payload_center.pos.z), 0, 1))
reward_terms.rationale: s_touch_jaw fires on any jaw contact (floor, anvil, payload), and the high floor_jaw_pad contact count suggests the agent was collecting this bonus without approaching the payload. Gate it by proximity to payload_center so floor contact while far away yields ~0 reward, while genuine payload contact near it retains full reward.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.rationale: Original term was max(z - target, 0), which is exactly zero until the payload reaches shelf height -- no gradient exists during the lift itself, matching the observed near-zero z_slide saturation and all-timeout outcomes. Replaced with a continuous shaping term that rewards rising height up to the target, plus a doubled bonus for clearing it, so the agent gets signal throughout the lift instead of only at completion.

reward_terms.name: control_efficiency
reward_terms.rationale: Minimize actuator effort to encourage smooth, efficient motion. Unchanged -- evidence does not implicate this term.

curriculum.advance_when: mean grip contact > 0.8 while gripper-to-payload distance < 0.05 for 200 steps
